description.vi: Cách Đầu mối làm việc của đội: nhận thư việc từ người, Lead và đội khác rồi trả lời cho đúng; biến mục tiêu thành việc mỗi tuần (cam kết đầu tuần, check-in cuối tuần, nhìn lại cuối chu kỳ). Không gắn với công ty hay sản phẩm nào.
description.en: How a team's Đầu mối runs the team: take work mail from the person, the Lead and other teams and reply well; turn the team's goals into tasks each week (Monday commitments, a Friday check-in, a cycle review). Tied to no company or product.

skills.name: coordinator-rhythm
skills.description: Load it when a recurring cadence task reaches you as the team's Đầu mối (the weekly commitments, the weekly check-in, the cycle review), or when a goal of your team changes: read the team's goals, last check-in, open tasks and signals, then commit at most a few tasks each linked to a goal, cancel or park tasks that serve no active goal, check in with a value, a confidence and one sentence, score the cycle, and propose next cycle's team goals as drafts.

skills.name: coordinator-mail
skills.description: Load it when work mail reaches you (a task the host started on you, often framed "Work sent to you by team …"): triage it (take it, decline with the right team:<id> from company op teams, fold it into an open task, reply Thiếu with what only the sender has, or hand it to the person through an approval or report_blocker), hand a member's part out inside this run with spawn_subagent rather than a mail you would end your turn on, and write your last message as the reply: an outcome word first (Xong, Xong một phần, Thiếu, Không nhận, Không làm được), the answer itself, where the rest is, what is left.
